The '''transpeeder''' was a type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] that was produced by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Transpeeders were intended for use by [[Army/Legends|military]] forces and consisted of a chair mounted on a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]].The model was eventually superseded by Baktoid's [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platform]].

==Characteristics==
The transpeeder was a type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] built by the vehicle manufacturer [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]. The model was cheap to produce and had a simple design, consisting of a chair for a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] mounted onto a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] to provide it with propulsion. It was two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and could reach speeds of up to 270 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|km/h]]. The transpeeder was armed at its front with two small fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|light laser cannons]], though in some variants one [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] was replaced with a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] [[Grenade launcher/Legends|launcher]]. It had capacity for up to five [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo and could not accommodate any passengers. A new transpeeder was priced at 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while a used model typically sold for 7,000 credits.<ref name="AEG" />

==Role==
[[File:STAP-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|A Single Trooper Aerial Platform, the vehicle that superseded the transpeeder]]
Designed for [[Army/Legends|military]] use, the transpeeder was intended to improve the combat effectiveness of an individual [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. The vehicle also saw civilian application and transpeeders were sold to [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security forces]].<ref name="AEG" />

==History==
The transpeeder entered production during latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and never gained significant popularity with Republic military leaders. Most transpeeders in military service were eventually superseded by the [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Vehicle]],<ref name="AEG" /> another model of single-person aerial vehicle manufactured by Baktoid.<ref name="Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The transpeeder was mentioned in the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', a [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook that was written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]].<ref name="AEG" />
